analysis:
Examined both supplied test revisions, helper patch and metadata, and the bounded added-test excerpt. SandboxStatusTests.swift:78–99 (head) adds work-disk decoding/rendering assertions: pathless entries are omitted, external disks show capacity/slots and offline detail, and an online internal-only disk is hidden. These assertions establish intended display behavior, not filesystem validation or serving authorization. SandboxTestSupport.swift:187–201 (head) adds a fake installer capability marker and plan stderr output; stderr remains shell-quoted through quoted() at 226–227. This is test scaffolding, with no demonstrated new production execution or disclosure path. The visible SandboxWorkDiskTests.swift excerpt covers APFS/ownership fixtures, external plan fields and path-option parsing; its remaining source is not supplied in this batch.
No concrete security regression is supported by these test changes. Relevant integration contracts are TB-013/T-061 and A-019 (installer execution as owner), TB-012/T-059/T-060 and A-018 (availability), and T-041 (external encrypted cache storage). Integration must examine the production implementations of SandboxWorkDisk, Sandbox.Setup, SandboxInstaller, SandboxAddonStatus and SandboxStatusView: argument forwarding, preflight versus installer validation, bounded/untrusted status rendering, and whether any cache relocation preserves volume identity, ownership, encryption and fail-closed missing-mount behavior. Test fixtures do not prove those controls or their absence. No supplied change alters attestation, hop encryption, token handling or payment accounting; existing job/payment messages are unchanged. Production source and the rest of the added tests are needed to resolve the work-disk security conclusions.
